design.scope: Existing28 stage-specific ventricular RNA groups; no new RNA clustering or changed membership
design.reference_normalization: log2(1+CPM),381 shared genes; same assay scaling/30-neighbor/temperature0.10 as preceding benchmark
design.RNA_split: Within original library and group, cell IDs hash-sorted with heart-fine-resolution-v1, ranks modulo4:0/1 calibration,2 validation,3 assessment
design.hierarchy: Merge maximum bidirectional class-normalized calibration confusion; no assessment labels used for merges or cut selection
design.selected_cut: Largest K with every class passing both-library quality criteria on validation quarter; then assess this frozen cut on final quarter
design.half_gene_sets: Sorted sha256 of heart-fine-panel-v1:gene, alternating halves
design.panel_marker_selection: Up to6 genes; minimum group-minus-rest mean log1pCP10k effect>=0.15 in both original libraries and raw/corrected counts; raw detection>=0.15 in both; excludes generic chamber anchors

spatial_tiers.multi_check_candidate: weight>=0.70,margin>=0.20,both libraries agree,original-count reference agrees,>=2 measured supporting genes,original fine class passes final RNA assessment criteria
spatial_tiers.library_raw_consistent: weight>=0.50,margin>=0.10,both libraries agree,original reference agrees,>=2 measured supporting genes

local_design.selection: Lowest threshold passing validation in both libraries; assessment evaluates that frozen threshold.
local_design.spatial_local_flag: Selected threshold and margin, both full-library projections agree, original-reference projection agrees,>=2 measured supporting genes, class passes selective RNA assessment.
local_design.interpretation: Internal selective RNA label recovery; neither a calibrated Xenium probability nor independent anatomical truth.
